purpose: Pre-ETL license screening. Catalog-level terms are recorded separately from item-specific attestations; catalog evidence alone never makes an item eligible.

allowed.condition: Allow only after the license is verified for each specific item and its scope is established.
Allow only after unrestricted terms and their scope are verified for each specific item.

rejected.reason: Non-commercial and share-alike restrictions are disallowed.
Missing or unverified item-level license evidence is not eligible for inclusion.

policy.unverified_item_rule: A user-declared source-level license does not establish an item's license or scope; items remain excluded pending item-specific evidence.
